tools.name: aphrody_google_doc_export
tools.description: Export a publicly shared Google Document to plain text.

tools.name: aphrody_google_sheet_export
tools.description: Export a publicly shared Google Spreadsheet to CSV.

tools.name: aphrody_google_suggest
tools.description: Get real-time query suggestions from Google Autocomplete.

tools.name: aphrody_google_supported_languages
tools.description: List all 195 official supported Google Cloud Translation languages, optionally localized in target language.

tools.name: aphrody_search
tools.description: Powerful Google Web Search. Returns ranked organic results (title, URL, snippet) and, with `rich`, the featured snippet / knowledge panel / People-Also-Ask / related searches. Authenticates automatically from ~/.aphrody/cookies/google.json when present. Supports verticals (web/images/news/videos/books).

tools.name: aphrody_web_crawl
tools.description: Run one bounded Rust crawl pass with optional persistent SQLite frontier, domain limits, robots checks and sitemap discovery. Returns page summaries and frontier statistics.

tools.name: aphrody_x_algorithm_rank
tools.description: Rank a list of X posts using the local port of X For You algorithm (filters + weighted engagement scorer + author diversity from xai-org/x-algorithm). Returns ScoredPost[].

tools.name: aphrody_x_client
tools.description: Native X / Twitter client (cookie auth, no API key). Fetch a profile, a user's tweets, search the Latest timeline, trending news, or resolve the authenticated account. Auth uses an auth_token + ct0 cookie pair from the session file / X_AUTH_TOKEN+X_CT0 env, or an explicit cookie string.

tools.name: advanced_recon
tools.description: Resolve a host's A/AAAA records and probe a list of TCP ports for OPEN / CLOSED-FILTERED / TIMEOUT, using async tokio sockets (5 s resolve budget, 200 ms per port; ports default to 80, 443, 8080). That is the whole tool: it performs NO OSINT — no WHOIS, no certificate transparency, no passive DNS, no subdomain enumeration.

tools.name: aphrody_a2a_call
tools.description: Call the local Aphrody A2A v1 JSON-RPC backend through aphrody-mcp. The endpoint is APHRODY_A2A_ENDPOINT (legacy APHRODY_A2A_URL) or http://127.0.0.1:8788/; only canonical A2A methods are accepted.

tools.name: aphrody_describe_image
tools.description: Describe an image with a local vision-language model: caption (one short description), dense_region (per-region descriptions with normalised boxes), full_page_ocr (text only, never a description), or vqa (a free-form question, needs `question`). Fully offline; nothing is downloaded. Unlike aphrody_ocr this tool MAY describe a picture — use aphrody_ocr when the answer must be a transcription. Returns { image, mode, model, text, description, elapsed_ms, raw? }.

tools.name: aphrody_home_query
tools.description: Search the agent home database (one SQLite file per home: `<home>/db/aphrody.sqlite`) with a single hybrid query over document chunks, code-graph nodes and memories (FTS5 plus one reciprocal-rank fusion). Optional kinds filter (chunk, node, memory) and profile (aphrody, dbfr, ie). Build it with `aphrody home index <dir>`. Returns ranked hits with path, line and snippet.

tools.name: aphrody_home_status
tools.description: Status of the agent home database: path, schema version and table counts (sources, files, docs, chunks, graph nodes and edges, memories, sessions).

tools.name: aphrody_jev_decide
tools.description: Answer typed questions about a state with the Jev decision models, without generating text. Each question is a noul (probability of yes), a choice (one option out of a set) or a score (position along ordered levels). Use for routing, classification, guardrails and ranking. Served by the TypeSafe SaaS, Cloudflare for large states, or a local jeff server on outage; returns the backend used.

tools.name: aphrody_job_status
tools.description: Inspect the background job queue. With `id`: the job plus its trailing NDJSON log lines. Without: a filtered listing (state/kind/limit). Both include queue-wide counts so a job that no worker handles is visible as queued rather than mistaken for slow.

tools.name: aphrody_job_submit
tools.description: Submit a background job to the persistent queue at ~/.aphrody/jobs/jobs.db and return its id immediately. Executes nothing and downloads nothing: the job stays queued until a worker claims it. Returns { id, kind, state, priority, max_attempts, created_at, log_path, db_path, queue, note }.

tools.name: aphrody_mcp_call
tools.description: Proxy-invoke a tool on any MCP server configured in mcp.json. Spawns/connects the target server transparently (stdio or HTTP), runs the `initialize` + `tools/call` handshake, and returns the target tool's raw `result` payload wrapped in a small envelope { server, tool, result }. Use to chain MCP servers (e.g. delegate to `github`, `context7`) without separate client wiring.

tools.name: aphrody_ocr
tools.description: Read an image with a local vision-language model (llama.cpp + an installed GGUF from the aphrody model store) and return markdown. Fully offline; nothing is downloaded. A page with no readable text returns markdown=null and textless=true — never an empty string and never a description of the picture. Every transcription is audited on the way out: `suspect` is true when the text carries a defect that should stop a deposit (a stuck/repeating generation, a leaked control token, surviving markup), with the individual `findings` listed. The audit annotates, it never removes text. Returns { image, markdown, textless, suspect, findings, elapsed_ms, model, runner, raw? }.

tools.name: aphrody_rag_context
tools.description: Same retrieval as aphrody_rag_search, rendered as a numbered, citable Markdown context block ready to paste into a prompt.

tools.name: aphrody_rag_search
tools.description: Search the local aphrody RAG index (SQLite FTS5, built by `aphrody rag index`; $APHRODY_RAG_DB or ~/.aphrody/rag/index.db). Returns ranked chunks with path, lines and score as JSON.

tools.name: aphrody_schema
tools.description: Return machine-readable backend contracts from the unified endpoint. `aphrody` returns the live MCP tool schemas, `web` lists the web backend tools, `n2b` returns its canonical report JSON Schema, `a2a` returns the A2A v1 JSON-RPC contract, and `all` returns every local contract plus the live web catalogue when available.

tools.name: aphrody_shenron_llm_chat
tools.description: Chat through Aphrody's configured local OpenAI-compatible model for Shenron. Returns answer and model. Requires the configured model backend.

tools.name: aphrody_shenron_ocr
tools.description: Transcribe one base64 image with Aphrody's local OCR for Shenron. Returns text, textless, suspect, findings and languageApplied=false. Requires a binary built with the ocr feature and installed OCR model.

tools.name: aphrody_shenron_rag_ingest
tools.description: Upsert one Shenron passage into Aphrody's RAG corpus using a stable sourceId such as shenron:<rowid>. Optional originSourceId, kind, lang and entity preserve source metadata. Requires the Aphrody RAG database.

tools.name: aphrody_shenron_rag_search
tools.description: Search the Dragon Ball corpus held by Aphrody. Accepts q, limit, lang, kind, sourceId (the original corpus ID), and entity. Returns stable sourceId values, source URL, a bounded passage, and lexical mode.

tools.name: aphrody_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe audio fully locally by driving whisper.cpp with weights from the aphrody model store (catalog id such as whisper-base-en, or a GGML path). Never falls back to a network API and never downloads: a missing runtime or missing weights is a structured error. Audio must be 16 kHz mono WAV. Returns { text, language, duration_s, segments, backend, binary, model, weights }.

tools.name: aphrody_web_call
tools.description: Call native Aphrody Web tools by their public or historical name through this endpoint (browser, crawl, Google, Gemini, X, archive). Use aphrody_capabilities to inspect the tools available in this build.

tools.name: aphrody_web_extract_html
tools.description: Extract article text, Markdown and metadata from supplied HTML using the shared Aphrody Rust Web library. No browser subprocess is started.

tools.name: awesome_fetch
tools.description: Fetch, parse, and structure a canonical curated Awesome list from GitHub (e.g. 'sindresorhus/awesome', 'oven-sh/awesome-bun', 'rust-unofficial/awesome-rust', 'tauri-apps/awesome-tauri'). Returns structured categories, entries, and GitHub metadata.

tools.name: awesome_search
tools.description: Search across curated Awesome lists (Bun, Rust, Tauri, Sindresorhus/Awesome) for libraries, frameworks, tools, and resources matching a keyword.

tools.name: coding_style_guide
tools.description: Fetch official coding style guidelines for Google projects (Chromium, Android, C++, Python, TypeScript, etc.).

tools.name: context7_query_docs
tools.description: Retrieve up-to-date documentation and code examples from Context7 for a specific library and topic. Pass a libraryId resolved via `context7_resolve_library_id`. Returns raw markdown.

tools.name: context7_resolve_library_id
tools.description: Resolve a package or product name to a Context7-compatible library ID (e.g. '/vercel/next.js') and return matching libraries with descriptions and source reputation. First step before `context7_query_docs`.

tools.name: docs_auto_search
tools.description: Single-shot documentation lookup that queries four backends in parallel — Context7, Microsoft Learn, Microsoft code samples, and GitHub (authoritative repos, llms.txt, and READMEs) — and returns one fused markdown report. Provide `library_name` when known to unlock the Context7 deep fetch and targeted GitHub repo discovery; provide `language` to narrow Microsoft code samples.

tools.name: firefly_generate
tools.description: Generate image(s) with Adobe Firefly Services (v3, async). OAuth server-to-server: set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID and FIREFLY_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment. Cross-platform, headless cloud API (no Photoshop install). Optionally save to a directory. Returns { count, outputs:[{ seed, content_type, bytes, saved_path? }] }.

tools.name: firefly_generative_expand
tools.description: Generative expand (Adobe Firefly v3): enlarge an image's canvas to width×height, AI-filling the new area (optional prompt). image_url must be Adobe-readable. Optionally save_dir. Returns { count, image_urls, saved_paths }. Set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.

tools.name: firefly_generative_fill
tools.description: Generative fill (Adobe Firefly v3): replace the masked region of an image with prompt-guided content. image_url + mask_url (white = fill) must be Adobe-readable. Optionally save_dir. Returns { count, image_urls, saved_paths }. Set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.

tools.name: firefly_to_photoshop
tools.description: Bridge: generate an image with Adobe Firefly, then route it through the cloud Photoshop API. With output_url it converts the result to that URL/format (e.g. an editable PSD); without it, returns the layer manifest of the generated image. Set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.

tools.name: git_ingest
tools.description: Ingest a Git repository URL or local directory into a prompt-ready LLM digest (GitIngest standard with directory tree, token counts, and curated file contents).

tools.name: github_docs_search
tools.description: Search GitHub repositories intelligently for documentation, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and prompt-ready digests. Discovers authoritative open-source repositories matching the query, inspects llms.txt and README, and optionally generates full GitIngest digests.

tools.name: microsoft_code_sample_search
tools.description: Search for official Microsoft / Azure code snippets and examples. Use before writing code (find a working pattern to follow) or after errors (compare your code against a known-good sample). Optional language filter narrows results to a single SDK ecosystem.

tools.name: microsoft_docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch and convert a Microsoft documentation page into markdown format. Use after `microsoft_docs_search` when an excerpt is cut off or you need the full tutorial / configuration guide / API reference page.

tools.name: microsoft_docs_search
tools.description: Search official Microsoft documentation and return up to 10 concise, high-quality content chunks (max 500 tokens each), including title, URL and excerpt. Use first to get a quick, reliable overview of any Microsoft / Azure / .NET / Windows / M365 / Power Platform technology.

tools.name: n2b
tools.description: Scan and migrate a Node.js codebase to Bun using n2b. Detects Node-specific patterns, shims, polyfills, package configurations, and automatically migrates or fixes them.

tools.name: native_hooks
tools.description: Query native OS state (CPU count, memory usage, page size) directly via OS APIs, bypassing WMI or higher-level abstractions.

tools.name: photoshop_action_json
tools.description: Play an actionJSON program (a recorded Photoshop action set as JSON) over a PSD/image via the cloud Photoshop API (documentOperations). `actions` is the actionJSON array. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_auto_straighten
tools.description: Auto-straighten (Upright perspective correction) via the cloud Lightroom API. input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_auto_tone
tools.description: Auto-tone an image via the cloud Lightroom API (AI exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, vibrance). input_url readable by Adobe; output_url writable. format = png|jpg|psd|tiff|dng. Job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_create_mask
tools.description: Create a subject/background alpha mask for an image (Sensei mask). input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_depth_blur
tools.description: Depth-of-field blur via the cloud Photoshop API (depthBlur Neural Filter). input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_document_operations
tools.description: Apply layer edits (and optionally render) on a PSD via the cloud Photoshop API (documentOperations). `options` is the layer-edit JSON tree. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_edit
tools.description: Apply explicit Camera-Raw adjustments via the cloud Lightroom API (edit): exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, temperature, tint, vibrance, saturation, clarity, dehaze, texture, sharpness. Only the set fields are applied. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_live_batchplay
tools.description: Run a batchPlay command array inside the RUNNING Photoshop (in-app UXP plugin) — the universal driver for ANY Photoshop operation (the same ActionDescriptor JSON ScriptListener/Alchemist emit). `commands` is the array; `options` is optional. Returns { ok, result } with batchPlay's response descriptors. Requires the aphrody UXP panel loaded.

tools.name: photoshop_live_exec
tools.description: Evaluate arbitrary UXP JavaScript inside the RUNNING Photoshop (in-app plugin) with app/photoshop/constants/core/batchPlay in scope — full internal access for anything not expressible as one batchPlay array. `return` a JSON-serializable value. Requires the aphrody UXP panel loaded.

tools.name: photoshop_live_info
tools.description: Report the running Photoshop's state via the in-app UXP plugin: app version, active document (name, dimensions, mode), and the layer tree. Requires the aphrody UXP panel loaded in Photoshop. Returns { ok, result }.

tools.name: photoshop_manifest
tools.description: Get the layer manifest (tree, dimensions, mode) of a PSD/image via the cloud Photoshop API. input_url must be readable by Adobe (presigned S3 / Azure SAS / Dropbox / Creative Cloud). Returns the Photoshop job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_product_crop
tools.description: Content-aware product crop via the cloud Photoshop API (productCrop). input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background of an image (Sensei cutout), returning a transparent cut-out. input_url readable, output_url writable (png recommended). Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: photoshop_rendition
tools.description: Render a PSD/image to an output URL via the cloud Photoshop API (renditionCreate). format = png|jpg|psd|tiff|dng. output_url must be a writable destination (presigned PUT / SAS / CC). Returns the job JSON.

tools.name: re_disasm
tools.description: Disassemble x86-64 instructions from a binary file (PE, ELF, raw shellcode, firmware dump — any byte sequence). Returns a JSON object with `path`, `offset`, `rip`, `limit`, `count`, and an `instructions` array. Each instruction entry contains `offset` (byte offset from the start of the decoded slice), `address` (virtual address = rip + offset), `bytes_hex` (lowercase hex of raw instruction bytes), `mnemonic` (bare mnemonic, e.g. `"mov"`), and `text` (full Intel-syntax line, e.g. `"mov rbp,rsp"`). Decoding stops at the instruction limit, the end of the slice, or the first invalid/unknown encoding — whichever comes first. Errors with a structured envelope on read failure, oversized inputs (> 100 MB), or out-of-bounds offset.

tools.name: re_sections
tools.description: Parse a PE32/PE64/ELF32/ELF64 binary and return its section table as a JSON object. Each entry contains `name` (string), `vaddr` (u64), `size` (u64 bytes on disk), and `entropy` (Shannon bits/byte, null for .bss-style sections with no on-disk content). High entropy (>= 7.0) signals compression or encryption (UPX, custom packers). Returns a structured envelope on read failure, oversized inputs, or unknown binary formats.

tools.name: re_strings
tools.description: Extract printable ASCII and UTF-16LE strings from any file (binary, firmware, PE, ELF, data blob). Returns a JSON object with `path`, `min_len`, `limit`, and a `strings` array of deduplicated runs. Works on any file format — no binary parsing required. Errors with a structured envelope on read failure or if the file exceeds 100 MB.

tools.name: re_triage
tools.description: Triage a binary file (PE32/PE64/ELF32/ELF64): detect format via magic, parse with goblin, extract sections with per-section Shannon entropy, imports, exports, ASCII/UTF-16LE strings sample (≤ 64 entries, min length 6), and a SHA-256 fingerprint. Pure Rust, no GPL deps. Returns a TriageReport JSON object. Errors with structured envelope on read failures or oversized inputs.

tools.name: screen_capture
tools.description: Capture the whole primary screen (or a window by title substring) as a PNG and return it base64-encoded so a vision model can see it. Optionally also save to disk. Local-only. Returns { mime, bytes, base64, saved_path }.

tools.name: start_dashboard
tools.description: Start a loopback HTTP server exposing live telemetry about THIS MCP process: GET /health (liveness) and GET /info (PID, uptime, memory, and a counter of /info hits). Binds 127.0.0.1 only - set APHRODY_MCP_DASHBOARD_HOST to widen it deliberately. Runs in the background for the lifetime of the MCP process and cannot be stopped by a tool call.

tools.name: sync_external_agents
tools.description: Mirror the sessions of the other coding agents on this machine (Antigravity CLI `agy`, Codex, Claude Code) into ~/.aphrody/sessions/<agent>/<session_id>.jsonl, incrementally: per-file byte offsets mean a re-run only ingests lines appended since, and each line is normalised to {agent, session_id, workspace, ts, role, text, source_path, offset}. Optionally matches running agent processes to the sessions they write (live, default true) and feeds user/assistant turns into the local memory store (memory, default true). Returns the JSON summary { records_ingested, sources_scanned, sources_updated, agents, sessions, live_processes, memory, issues }.

tools.name: universal_web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch any webpage from the internet and convert it to clean Markdown. Fetched directly by aphrody and converted in-process (no third-party reader). Highly recommended for reading online developer documentation, issue trackers, or tutorials.

tools.name: upstream_info
tools.description: Live facts about one catalogue upstream from the GitHub API: head of the followed ref, latest release, licence, pushed date, archived flag, and whether it moved since the commit recorded in the manifest.

tools.name: upstream_list
tools.description: List the upstream catalogue (config/upstream-sources.json): the few vital checkouts and the reference upstreams that are never cloned (codex, ollama, mistral.rs, vllm, WSL, ...), with tier, purpose and consumers.

tools.name: upstream_read
tools.description: Read one file of a catalogue upstream at its live ref (no clone). Text over 256 KiB is cut and flagged `truncated`.

tools.name: upstream_search
tools.description: Code search inside one catalogue upstream (GitHub code search, needs a GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN).

tools.name: upstream_tree
tools.description: List a directory of one catalogue upstream at its live ref (no clone). `path` defaults to the repository root.

tools.name: voice_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesise speech from text via the aphrody-voice ElevenLabs adapter. Returns { audio_base64, mime_type, duration_ms, bytes, voice }. Requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in env.

tools.name: voice_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe base64-encoded audio via aphrody-voice-stt. Prefers offline whisper.cpp (set APHRODY_WHISPER_MODEL to a GGML model path); falls back to the OpenAI Whisper REST API (OPENAI_API_KEY) — so this tool MAY upload the audio; use `aphrody_transcribe` (feature stt-local) when it must not leave the machine. Returns { text, confidence, confidence_note, language, duration_s, segments, backend, mime_type }. `confidence` is always null: neither backend reports one and this tool does not invent one.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search for available tools and their schemas by keyword when the initial toolset does not cover a specific action.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update or record the agent's multi-step execution plan and current progress.

tools.name: view_image
tools.description: Load a local image file and inspect it visually (for vision-capable models).

tools.name: nu_commands
tools.description: List Nushell commands with their descriptions, optionally filtered.

tools.name: nu_eval
tools.description: Evaluate Nushell code and return its value as JSON (tables are arrays of records). Pass data through `vars` (read as $env.<name>) instead of splicing it into code. External command output is captured, stdout then stderr.

tools.name: nu_help
tools.description: Full help of one Nushell command: signature, flags, examples.

tools.name: rag_context
tools.description: Assemble a prompt-ready <retrieved_context> block bounded by token budget for direct model ingestion.

tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Search indexed codebase files and documentation using hybrid retrieval (FTS5 BM25 + dense vector scan + RRF fusion).

tools.name: web_ingest
tools.description: Retrieve a web page through Aphrody OS and index it into the local RAG store so later rag_search/rag_context calls can retrieve it.

tools.name: systemd_journal_query
tools.description: Query log messages from systemd journald with unit, severity level, and limit filtering

tools.name: systemd_list_units
tools.description: List all active and configured systemd units, targets and services

tools.name: systemd_load_unit_file
tools.description: Load and register a new systemd unit from INI text content

tools.name: systemd_reload_unit
tools.description: Reload configuration for a systemd service

tools.name: systemd_restart_unit
tools.description: Restart a systemd service

tools.name: systemd_start_unit
tools.description: Start or activate a systemd service or target

tools.name: systemd_stop_unit
tools.description: Stop or deactivate a systemd service or target

tools.name: systemd_unit_status
tools.description: Get detailed status, state, PID, uptime, and dependencies of a specific systemd unit

tools.name: analyze_pe
tools.description: Performs static analysis and symbol recovery on a target Windows PE binary (.exe or .dll). Recovers sections, imports, entry point disassembly, and maps symbols using heuristics (no execution).

tools.name: aob_scan
tools.description: Scans raw file bytes for an Array of Bytes (AOB) pattern with optional wildcards (? or ??). Pattern format: '48 8B ? ? 48 89' or 'E8 ? ? ? ? 85 C0'. Returns matching offsets in the binary.

tools.name: asar_list
tools.description: Lists files contained inside an Electron ASAR archive (.asar) without extraction or execution. Returns relative paths, offsets, and sizes.

tools.name: binary_aes_ctr_decrypt
tools.description: AES-128/256-CTR decryption of a file using caller-supplied key (hex) and 16-byte IV (hex). Streams large files. Returns sha256 of the plaintext. Key must be 16 or 32 bytes; IV must be 16 bytes.

tools.name: binary_entropy_map
tools.description: Computes Shannon entropy (0..8 bits/byte) per fixed-size block. High entropy (>=7.5) typically indicates encryption or compression. Helps locate packed sections in a binary without disassembling.

tools.name: binary_extract_strings
tools.description: Extracts printable ASCII and UTF-16LE strings of >=minLength characters from a file. Returns up to maxResults entries with offset, encoding (ascii/utf16), and the string. Streams the file in 1 MiB chunks — works on large binaries.

tools.name: binary_hash_multi
tools.description: Computes MD5 + SHA1 + SHA256 of a file in a single pass. Streams the file (any size). Returns all three hex digests.

tools.name: binary_list_cpk
tools.description: Lists files inside a CRIWARE CPK archive (used by Inazuma Eleven Victory Road, many Japanese games). Parses the @UTF table at the start of the file. Returns up to maxEntries rows with internal path, offset, size, compressed size, CRC32.

tools.name: binary_parse_pe_header
tools.description: Parses the PE/COFF header of a Windows executable or DLL. Returns machine (x64/arm64/x86), characteristics, image base, entry RVA, subsystem (gui/console), is64bit flag, and section table (name + RVA + size + flags).

tools.name: binary_section_dump
tools.description: Dumps one named section (e.g. '.text', '.rdata', '.rsrc') of a PE file to outputPath. Returns offset, size, sha256.

tools.name: binary_xor_decrypt
tools.description: Writes 'decrypted' = encryptedFile XOR repeating-key to outputPath. Key in hex (e.g. 'A5 5A 12' or 'A55A12'). Streams large files. If the encryption is a single-byte XOR, pass one byte. Returns sha256 of result.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Performs a mouse click at the given screen coordinates. button: 'left' | 'right' | 'middle'. clicks: 0 = hover only, 1 = single click, 2 = double click.

tools.name: computer_capture_screen
tools.description: Captures the primary desktop as a PNG image content block for visual computer use. Returns the screen dimensions and coordinate space in a text block before the image. Use computer_observe for a specific application and its UI Automation tree.

tools.name: computer_click
tools.description: Clicks a point in the selected application using native mouse input. x/y are relative to the outer window rectangle returned by computer_observe. The window is restored and focused by default. Re-observe after the click because menus and layouts may change.

tools.name: computer_click_element
tools.description: Finds one UI Automation element in a selected application and clicks its center. Prefer automationId when present, otherwise use an exact name, className or controlType from the latest computer_observe result. If multiple elements match, set occurrence (zero-based) or the tool returns the candidates without clicking.

tools.name: computer_drag
tools.description: Drags inside a selected application with interpolated native mouse movement. Coordinates are relative to the latest observed window image. Use this for canvas operations in Blender, Photoshop and similar software, then capture a fresh observation to verify the result.

tools.name: computer_key
tools.description: Sends a keyboard key or shortcut to a selected application using SendInput. Examples: ctrl+c, ctrl+shift+s, alt+f4, enter, tab, escape, f5. Windows-key shortcuts are intentionally rejected by this computer-use surface. Re-observe after actions that change UI.

tools.name: computer_observe
tools.description: Observes a Windows application for computer use. Returns structured window metadata and a native UI Automation tree as text, plus a PNG image content block when capture succeeds. windowHandle=0 selects the foreground window; otherwise use an exact HWND returned by window_enum_all. Coordinates in later computer_* actions are relative to this window image. Use this before every state-dependent click, type or drag.

tools.name: computer_ocr
tools.description: Runs local Windows OCR over the selected application screenshot and returns exact text with line/word bounding boxes. region coordinates are relative to the observed window image. format=json returns structured OCR; format=markdown returns the extracted text as Markdown. Set speak=true to synthesize and play the result with the installed Windows voice.

tools.name: computer_record_clip
tools.description: Records a bounded, exportable clip of a window or the primary desktop as an uncompressed AVI. The clip is written locally without ffmpeg or a cloud service. durationMs is 1..30000 and fps is 1..30.

tools.name: computer_scroll
tools.description: Scrolls a selected application using native wheel input. x/y are relative to the observed window image and identify the pane under the cursor. Re-observe after scrolling because lazy-loaded content and UI layouts can change.

tools.name: computer_speak
tools.description: Speaks text using the installed local Windows speech synthesizer and plays it immediately. No cloud API or key is used. Returns the generated WAV path for export or later playback.

tools.name: computer_type
tools.description: Types literal Unicode text into a selected application. Focuses the point first; set clear=true to replace the current field. x/y are relative to the observed window image. Maximum payload is 4096 characters per call. Re-observe before submitting or pressing Enter.

tools.name: coord_assign_task
tools.description: Publish a new .coord/CURRENT_TASK.md. The full body is the markdown content. Returns JSON {ok,bytes,path}.

tools.name: coord_query_stop
tools.description: Check the A2A kill switch — presence of .coord/STOP. Returns JSON {ok,stop:true|false}.

tools.name: coord_read_status
tools.description: Read the latest status block for an agent from .coord/STATUS_<AGENT>.txt. Returns JSON {ok,agent,status} (status='' when the file is absent).

tools.name: coord_read_task
tools.description: Read the current .coord/CURRENT_TASK.md. Returns JSON {ok,content} (content='' when absent).

tools.name: coord_report_status
tools.description: Write the status block for an agent. The block goes to .coord/STATUS_<AGENT>.txt where <AGENT> is the upper-case form of `agent`. Returns JSON {ok,agent,bytes}.

tools.name: copy_path
tools.description: Copies a file or directory to a destination.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Deletes a file or directory. Set recursive=true for non-empty directories.

tools.name: delete_registry_entry
tools.description: Deletes a registry value (when name is set) or the entire key (when name is null/empty).

tools.name: disable_scheduled_task
tools.description: Disables a scheduled task via schtasks /Change /Disable.

tools.name: enable_scheduled_task
tools.description: Enables a scheduled task via schtasks /Change /Enable.

tools.name: gamepad_create_xbox360
tools.description: Allocates a virtual Xbox 360 controller via ViGEmBus and connects it to the system. The virtual controller is indexed by slotIndex (0–7). Returns {"success":true,"slot":N,"vendorId":"045e","productId":"028e"} on success. Requires ViGEmBus: https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases

tools.name: gamepad_destroy
tools.description: Removes and frees the virtual Xbox 360 controller at the given slot. Safe to call if the slot was never created (no-op).

tools.name: gamepad_destroy_all
tools.description: Removes and frees ALL active virtual Xbox 360 controllers created in this process. Use as cleanup before shutdown or when resetting gamepad state.

tools.name: gamepad_environment
tools.description: Diagnoses the ViGEmBus virtual gamepad environment. Reports whether ViGEmBus registry key exists, whether the service is running, and whether ViGEmClient.dll can be located on disk. Install ViGEmBus from https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases if absent.

tools.name: gamepad_press_button
tools.description: Presses one or more buttons on a virtual Xbox 360 controller then releases them. buttonMask uses the same bitmask as GamepadSendXbox360State. holdMs: how long to hold the buttons down (clamped to [1, 5000] ms).

tools.name: gamepad_send_xbox360_state
tools.description: Sends a full Xbox 360 controller state update. buttons bitmask: DPAD_UP=1, DPAD_DOWN=2, DPAD_LEFT=4, DPAD_RIGHT=8, START=16, BACK=32, L3=64, R3=128, LB=256, RB=512, GUIDE=1024, A=4096, B=8192, X=16384, Y=32768. Axes lx/ly/rx/ry: [-32768, 32767]. Triggers lt/rt: [0, 255].

tools.name: get_active_power_plan
tools.description: Returns the GUID and friendly name of the active Windows power plan.

tools.name: get_clipboard_text
tools.description: Reads UTF-16 text content from the Windows clipboard.

tools.name: get_cpu_info
tools.description: Returns CPU topology as JSON: logical processors, physical cores, NUMA nodes, cache sizes (L1/L2/L3 aggregate), architecture.

tools.name: get_cpu_usage
tools.description: Samples global CPU usage over a short interval (default 250 ms, clamp 50-2000) via GetSystemTimes. Returns usage/idle percent and raw idle/kernel/user deltas in seconds. Kernel time as reported by Windows INCLUDES idle time; this tool subtracts it before computing the percentage.

tools.name: get_defender_status
tools.description: Returns Windows Defender state as JSON: AntivirusEnabled, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, BehaviorMonitorEnabled, TamperProtected, AntivirusSignatureVersion, LastQuickScanStartUtc, LastFullScanStartUtc, ThreatCount.

tools.name: get_disk_info
tools.description: Returns logical-drive info (root, type, total/free/available bytes) as JSON via GetLogicalDriveStrings + GetDiskFreeSpaceEx.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Returns metadata for a file or directory as JSON: size, dates, type, hidden flag.

tools.name: get_gpu_preferences
tools.description: Reads all per-app GPU preferences from HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences. Returns each registered exe path with its raw preference string ('GpuPreference=N;').

tools.name: get_hags_mode
tools.description: Reads HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers\HwSchMode. 0 = WDDM CPU scheduling, 1 = OS-managed default, 2 = Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling. Requires WDDM 2.7+ (Win10 20H1+ / Win11). Reboot to take effect.

tools.name: get_memory_info
tools.description: Returns physical / virtual / page-file memory state as JSON via GlobalMemoryStatusEx.

tools.name: get_network_adapters
tools.description: Lists network adapters (Name, Description, Status, MAC, link speed, IPv4 addresses) as JSON.

tools.name: get_os_info
tools.description: Returns OS version info (ProductName, EditionId, DisplayVersion, BuildNumber, UBR, InstallationType, OSArchitecture, MachineName, UserName) as JSON.

tools.name: get_registry_value
tools.description: Reads a registry value. Path uses PowerShell-style hive prefixes (HKCU:\, HKLM:\, HKCR:\, HKU:\, HKCC:\).

tools.name: get_system_profile
tools.description: Récupère le profil système complet pour vérifier l'état d'optimisation du poste.

tools.name: golang_scan
tools.description: Inspects a target binary for Golang runtime signatures (pclntab) and extracts Go package/symbol indicators. Passive inspection without execution.

tools.name: keyboard_hold
tools.description: Holds an arbitrary virtual key down (no release). Pair with KeyboardRelease to let go. Useful for charging mechanics, sustained movement keys, modifiers held across multiple ops.

tools.name: keyboard_release
tools.description: Releases a virtual key previously held by KeyboardHold.

tools.name: keyboard_scan_code
tools.description: Sends a single key by raw hardware SCAN CODE instead of virtual key. Some games (and anti-cheats) ignore Send-Input from virtual keys but accept scan codes because they match real keyboards. action: 'down' | 'up' | 'tap' (down+up).

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Kills a process by PID (preferred) or name. Returns the count of terminated processes. Force=true requests an immediate kill (default true). PPL-protected processes return a labelled error.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launches a Windows application. Accepts an absolute path to an .exe (e.g. 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad.exe'), an executable name resolvable via PATH (e.g. 'notepad.exe'), or a shell URI (mailto:, explorer:, ms-settings:).

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Lists directory contents as streamed JSON. Set recursive=true to descend, showHidden=true to include hidden entries, pattern to filter by glob, and exclude to omit matching entry names and skip matching directories. Exclusion matching is ASCII case-insensitive. Hard cap: 10000 entries returned; result is marked truncated when exceeded.

tools.name: list_listening_ports
tools.description: Lists TCP/IPv4 listening ports (LISTEN state only) as JSON.

tools.name: list_power_plans
tools.description: Lists installed Windows power plans with their GUID, friendly name, and whether they are currently active. Returns JSON with the active GUID at the top.

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: Lists running processes as JSON. Filter by name (substring, case-insensitive). Sort by 'memory' (default), 'private', 'cpu', 'threads', 'handles' or 'name'. Limit caps the result count (default 20, max 1000). Backed by NtQuerySystemInformation for a single-syscall enumeration with full per-process metrics.

tools.name: list_registry_key
tools.description: Lists sub-keys and values under a registry key as JSON.

tools.name: list_scheduled_tasks
tools.description: Lists scheduled tasks under the given folder (default = root '\') via schtasks /Query. Returns JSON: Path, Name, State, LastRunTimeUtc, LastTaskResult, Enabled.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists Windows services as JSON. Filter by name substring (case-insensitive) and/or by status: Running, Stopped, Paused, StartPending, StopPending.

tools.name: list_tcp_connections
tools.description: Lists active TCP/IPv4 connections (Local/Remote address+port, state, owning PID) as JSON. Optional state filter (Listen, Established, CloseWait, TimeWait, Closed, SynSent, etc.).

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: Lists all visible top-level windows as JSON.

tools.name: mem_allocate
tools.description: Allocates virtual memory in a remote process via VirtualAllocEx. Returns the base address of the new region. protect: 'rw' (PAGE_READWRITE), 'rwx' (PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE), 'rx' (PAGE_EXECUTE_READ).

tools.name: mem_dump_region
tools.description: Reads up to MAX_DUMP_BYTES (4 MiB) from a memory region and writes them to a host-side file (default: %TEMP%\winclean_mcp_dump_<pid>_<addr>.bin). Returns the path and sha256 of the dump. Suspends the target during the read if suspend=true (avoids torn pages).

tools.name: mem_enable_debug_privilege
tools.description: Enables SeDebugPrivilege on the current MCP process so subsequent OpenProcess calls can attach to protected processes (most non-PPL user-mode targets). Idempotent — safe to call repeatedly.

tools.name: mem_free
tools.description: Releases a region previously allocated with MemAllocate (MEM_RELEASE).

tools.name: mem_get_module_base
tools.description: Returns the base address and size of a named module in a process. Name comparison is case-insensitive. Returns the first match.

tools.name: mem_list_modules
tools.description: Lists all loaded modules (DLLs + EXE) of a process. Returns name, baseAddress, and sizeOfImage for each module.

tools.name: mem_list_processes
tools.description: Lists running processes filtered by name substring (case-insensitive). Returns pid, name, and sessionId for each match. Leave nameFilter empty to list all processes (capped at 512).

tools.name: mem_protect
tools.description: Changes page protection on a memory region via VirtualProtectEx. Returns the previous protection flags. protect: rw | rwx | rx | ro | noaccess.

tools.name: mem_query_region
tools.description: Queries the virtual memory region containing the given address via VirtualQueryEx. Returns BaseAddress, RegionSize, State (Free/Reserve/Commit), Protect flags, and Type (Private/Image/Mapped).

tools.name: mem_read_bytes
tools.description: Reads raw bytes from a process's virtual address space via ReadProcessMemory. Length is capped at 65536 bytes. Returns hex-encoded bytes in the 'hex' field.

tools.name: mem_read_c_string
tools.description: Reads a null-terminated ASCII C-string from a process's virtual memory. Stops at the first NUL byte or maxLength bytes, whichever comes first.

tools.name: mem_read_double
tools.description: Reads a 64-bit IEEE 754 double (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory.

tools.name: mem_read_float
tools.description: Reads a 32-bit IEEE 754 float (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory.

tools.name: mem_read_int32
tools.description: Reads a signed 32-bit integer (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory.

tools.name: mem_read_int64
tools.description: Reads a signed 64-bit integer (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory.

tools.name: mem_read_utf16
tools.description: Reads a null-terminated UTF-16LE wide string from a process's virtual memory. Stops at the first NUL char or maxChars characters, whichever comes first.

tools.name: mem_resume_process
tools.description: Resumes every thread of the target process via NtResumeProcess.

tools.name: mem_scan_aob
tools.description: Scans a module's memory range for an IDA-style byte pattern (Array-of-Bytes scan). Pattern format: hex bytes separated by spaces, '??' as wildcard. Example: '48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 89 01'. Reads the module in 256 KiB chunks. Returns up to maxHits matching addresses.

tools.name: mem_scan_value_int32
tools.description: Cheat-Engine-style first scan: searches every committed RW page of the process for a 4-byte little-endian int32 value. Returns up to maxHits absolute addresses. Use MemReadInt32 to verify, then narrow via repeated scans.

tools.name: mem_suspend_process
tools.description: Suspends every thread of the target process via NtSuspendProcess.

tools.name: mem_write_bytes
tools.description: Writes raw bytes to a process's virtual memory via WriteProcessMemory. hex format: continuous hex digits (e.g. '48895c2408') or space-separated ('48 89 5c 24 08'). Length capped at 65536. Requires PROCESS_VM_WRITE — call MemEnableDebugPrivilege first for protected targets.

tools.name: mem_write_double
tools.description: Writes a 64-bit IEEE 754 double to a process's memory.

tools.name: mem_write_float
tools.description: Writes a 32-bit IEEE 754 float to a process's memory.

tools.name: mem_write_int32
tools.description: Writes a signed 32-bit little-endian integer to a process's memory.

tools.name: mem_write_int64
tools.description: Writes a signed 64-bit little-endian integer to a process's memory.

tools.name: mouse_drag_to
tools.description: Performs a mouse drag from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) with intermediate cursor moves so the OS drag-recognition logic actually fires (some apps reject teleported clicks). button: 'left' | 'right' | 'middle'. steps: number of intermediate move events (default 20).

tools.name: mouse_move_smooth
tools.description: Moves the mouse cursor smoothly along an interpolated path. Useful when the target window inspects MOUSEMOVE deltas (anti-automation heuristics) instead of a teleport via SetCursorPos. No button is pressed.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Moves the mouse cursor to the given screen coordinates. Set drag=true to perform a left-button drag from the current position to the target.

tools.name: move_path
tools.description: Moves or renames a file or directory.

tools.name: multi_edit
tools.description: Types the same text into multiple UIA elements identified by exact Name property. Takes a comma-separated label list and a single text payload. Resolves labels against a fresh Snapshot() of the foreground window.

tools.name: multi_select
tools.description: Clicks multiple UI elements identified by exact UIA Name property. Takes a comma-separated label list. Returns a JSON summary of clicked / notFound. Resolves labels against a fresh Snapshot() of the foreground window.

tools.name: perf_dwm_flush
tools.description: Forces the Desktop Window Manager to flush pending GPU work (DwmFlush). Useful right before / after a frame-rate critical operation to align with VBLANK.

tools.name: perf_empty_working_sets
tools.description: Trims the working set of EVERY accessible process via NtSetSystemInformation (MemoryEmptyWorkingSets). Each process keeps its memory but pages are pushed to standby, freeing physical RAM immediately. No process is killed.

tools.name: perf_memory_status
tools.description: Returns current physical and virtual memory pressure (MEMORYSTATUSEX). Use before/after PerfPurgeStandbyList or PerfEmptyWorkingSets to measure impact.

tools.name: perf_purge_standby_list
tools.description: Purges the Windows memory standby list (cached pages that are no longer in any working set but kept around for re-use). Frees RAM instantly without touching working sets. Equivalent to RAMMap → Empty Standby List. Requires elevation.

tools.name: perf_set_eco_mode
tools.description: Toggles Win11 EcoQoS (PowerThrottling) on a process. EcoMode = on → process is throttled to E-cores and capped frequency (saves power). EcoMode = off → release throttling (max performance). Reset all overrides with mode='default'.

tools.name: power_shell
tools.description: Executes a PowerShell command and returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and duration as JSON. Uses pwsh (PowerShell 7) when available, falling back to powershell.exe. Captures both streams without launching a window.

tools.name: query_event_log
tools.description: Queries a Windows Event Log channel via wevtapi and returns up to maxEvents entries (newest first) as JSON. Optional XPath filter (e.g. "*[System[Level=2]]" for Error-level only). Channel examples: Application, System, Security, Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient/Operational.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a UTF-8 text file. Supports optional line offset and limit for reading large files in chunks. Returns the content prefixed with the resolved absolute path.

tools.name: resize_window
tools.description: Resizes / moves a window matched by title substring. Set width/height to 0 to keep current size.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restarts a Windows service. Stops then starts, waiting up to 10s per phase.

tools.name: run_scheduled_task
tools.description: Runs a scheduled task immediately via schtasks /Run.

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Fetches a URL via HTTP GET and returns extracted plain text (script/style stripped, tags removed). Caps: 4 MiB download, 200k extracted chars, 30s timeout. For richer extraction prefer the docs MCP server (microsoft_docs_fetch / winclean_universal_web_fetch).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Captures the primary monitor to a BMP file on disk. Returns the absolute file path. Width/height default to the full virtual screen.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scrolls at the given screen coordinates. axis: 'vertical' | 'horizontal'. direction: up/down for vertical, left/right for horizontal. wheelTimes is the number of wheel notches (each notch ≈ 3 lines).

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Searches a directory tree for files matching a glob pattern. Exclude basenames with glob patterns; excluded directories are not traversed. Hard cap: 10000 results; result is marked truncated when exceeded.

tools.name: search_windows
tools.description: Effectue une recherche ultra-rapide sur le disque via l'indexeur natif Windows Search.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Displays a Windows tray balloon notification with title and message. Note: balloon tips replace classic Win32 toasts; modern WinRT toast (requires WindowsAppSDK projection) is not yet wired up.

tools.name: set_active_power_plan
tools.description: Activates a Windows power plan by GUID. Common GUIDs: 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e (Balanced), 8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c (High performance), a1841308-3541-4fab-bc81-f71556f20b4a (Power saver), e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 (Ultimate Performance).

tools.name: set_clipboard_text
tools.description: Writes UTF-16 text to the Windows clipboard.

tools.name: set_gpu_preference
tools.description: Writes per-app GPU preference in HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences. preference: 'SystemDefault' (0), 'PowerSaving' (1, iGPU), 'HighPerformance' (2, dGPU). exePath should be the absolute path to the .exe. Takes effect on next process launch. Format written: REG_SZ 'GpuPreference=N;'.

tools.name: set_hags_mode
tools.description: Writes HwSchMode in HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers. Valid: 0 (WDDM CPU), 1 (OS default), 2 (HW-accelerated GPU scheduling). Requires admin + reboot. Microsoft + NVIDIA recommend 2 on WDDM 2.7+ hardware (validates DLSS 3 Frame Generation).

tools.name: set_process_affinity
tools.description: Sets the CPU affinity mask of a process. The mask is a bitmask where bit N means 'process may run on logical processor N'. Pass 0 to reset to the system default. Returns previous and new mask in hex as JSON.

tools.name: set_process_priority
tools.description: Sets the Windows priority class of a process. Valid values: 'Idle', 'BelowNormal', 'Normal', 'AboveNormal', 'High', 'Realtime'. Returns previous and new class as JSON. Realtime requires Administrator and can starve system services.

tools.name: set_registry_value
tools.description: Writes a registry value. Creates the key if missing. Supported types: String, ExpandString, DWord, QWord, MultiString (newline-separated).

tools.name: shortcut
tools.description: Sends a keyboard shortcut. The combo is a '+'-separated list of keys, e.g. 'ctrl+c', 'ctrl+shift+esc', 'win+r', 'alt+f4'. Modifier keys: ctrl, shift, alt, win. Literal keys: a-z, 0-9, f1-f24, esc, enter, tab, space, backspace, delete, home, end, up, down, left, right.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Captures a UIA control-view tree snapshot of the foreground window via native UI Automation. Pass windowHandle to inspect a specific application without changing focus. Returns up to maxElements (default 200) descendants with name, controlType, automationId, className, bounds, focus and enabled state. Used by computer_* and MultiSelect/MultiEdit.

tools.name: start_service
tools.description: Starts a stopped Windows service. Waits up to 10s for the Running state.

tools.name: steam_get_game
tools.description: Returns full details of a single Steam game by appId. Returns {"success":false,...} if the appId is not found.

tools.name: steam_get_game_status
tools.description: Checks whether a Steam game process is currently running. Resolves install_dir and absolute_install_path from steam-scan.db. Executable name defaults to install_dir + ".exe". Returns {"appId":N,"running":bool,"pid":N|null,"executable":"...","installDir":"..."}.

tools.name: steam_kill_game
tools.description: Kills a running Steam game by executable name. Returns {"success":true,"pid":N,"killed":1} or {"success":false,"error":"not running"}.

tools.name: steam_launch_and_wait
tools.description: Launches a Steam game via steam://rungameid/{appId} then waits for the process to appear. Combines SteamLaunchByAppId + SteamWaitForLaunch in a single MCP call. Returns {"success":true,"pid":N,"elapsedMs":N} or {"success":false,...}.

tools.name: steam_launch_by_app_id
tools.description: Launches a Steam game via steam://rungameid/{appId}. Returns immediately — use SteamWaitForLaunch to block until the process is alive. Returns {"success":false,...} if Steam is not installed.

tools.name: steam_list_games
tools.description: Returns a JSON array of Steam games from steam-scan.db. By default only games whose files are present on disk (files_present > 0) are returned. Set includeMissing=true to include all rows regardless of files_present.

tools.name: steam_list_libraries
tools.description: Returns all Steam library paths with their game_count and total_size_bytes as recorded in steam-scan.db.

tools.name: steam_open_uri
tools.description: Opens any steam:// URI via ShellExecute. Allowed schemes: steam:// only. Returns {"success":true,"uri":"..."} or {"success":false,"error":"invalid scheme"}.

tools.name: steam_scan_summary
tools.description: Returns aggregate counts from steam-scan.db: nb_installs, nb_libraries, nb_games, nb_games_present, total_size_bytes.

tools.name: steam_vault_status
tools.description: Returns vault target metadata from secrets_vault_ref (target name, kind, description, user_hint). Secret material (passwords, tokens) is never included. Also attempts to invoke 'winclean-steam-auth list --json' (if present) for live vault status.

tools.name: steam_wait_for_launch
tools.description: Polls until the named process appears or the timeout elapses. Returns {"success":true,"pid":N,"elapsedMs":N} or {"success":false,"error":"timeout",...}.

tools.name: stop_service
tools.description: Stops a running Windows service. Waits up to 10s for the Stopped state.

tools.name: switch_to_window
tools.description: Brings a window to the foreground by partial title match (case-insensitive). Restores it if minimized.

tools.name: trim_process_working_set
tools.description: DIAGNOSTIC / DEBUG ONLY. Trims a process's working set via SetProcessWorkingSetSize(-1,-1). The OS does NOT free the pages — it moves them to the standby list. The next time the process touches that memory, it incurs a HARD PAGE FAULT (disk read). Mark Russinovich (Sysinternals creator, Azure CTO) documents this is anti-performance for normal use: see 'The Memory-Optimization Hoax'. The Microsoft API doc itself states the function is 'useful primarily for testing and tuning'. Use only on demonstrably-idle GUI apps where you accept the next-touch latency. Do NOT call in a loop.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Types text at the given screen coordinates. Set clear=true to send Ctrl+A + Delete before typing. Set pressEnter=true to submit with RETURN after typing. Max 4096 chars per call.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Pauses execution for the given duration in seconds (1..120).

tools.name: window_capture
tools.description: Captures the pixels of a window to a 24-bit BMP file via PrintWindow + GetDIBits. Works even when the window is MINIMISED, OFF-SCREEN or COVERED by another window (DWM redirection surface). Returns the saved BMP path and dimensions.

tools.name: window_close
tools.description: Sends WM_CLOSE to the window (graceful close request).

tools.name: window_enum_all
tools.description: Enumerates every top-level window (visible AND hidden). Filters by pid (0 = any), class substring, title substring (all case-insensitive). Returns hwnd, pid, classname, title, rect, visible, minimised, maximised flags.

tools.name: window_enum_children
tools.description: Enumerates direct + indirect child windows of a given HWND parent. Useful to drill into controls inside an app frame (edit fields, buttons, listviews).

tools.name: window_find_by_class
tools.description: Finds the first top-level HWND with the exact class name (case-sensitive) and optionally a matching window title. Returns hwnd=0 if not found.

tools.name: window_get_text
tools.description: Reads the text of a window or control via WM_GETTEXTLENGTH + WM_GETTEXT. Works on hidden controls; pair with WindowEnumChildren to locate the HWND.

tools.name: window_minimise_all
tools.description: Sends WM_KEYDOWN/UP for Win+D to the shell — minimises every visible window at once.

tools.name: window_move
tools.description: Moves and/or resizes a window by HWND. Set width/height to 0 to keep current size, set x/y to a value outside the visible desktop to park the window off-screen.

tools.name: window_post_message
tools.description: Posts a Win32 message to a window's queue via PostMessageW (asynchronous, non-blocking). Returns immediately even if the target ignores or hangs on the message.

tools.name: window_send_message
tools.description: Sends a Win32 message to a window via SendMessageW (synchronous). Useful to drive controls without stealing focus — e.g. WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP on a button HWND, WM_SETTEXT to set an edit field, WM_CLOSE to request close. wParam/lParam can be decimal or 0x-prefixed hex.

tools.name: window_set_opacity
tools.description: Sets per-window opacity (0..255). Promotes the window to WS_EX_LAYERED if needed. Use 255 = fully opaque, 0 = fully transparent (but still receives input unless clickThrough).

tools.name: window_set_text
tools.description: Sets the text of a window or control via WM_SETTEXT. Targets edit fields, captions, listbox items. For complex Unicode UIs prefer UIA.

tools.name: window_set_topmost
tools.description: Sets the TOPMOST flag on a window (Z-order pinned above all non-topmost windows).

tools.name: winml_get_version
tools.description: Returns the ONNX Runtime version string powering Windows ML on this machine.

tools.name: winml_inspect_onnx
tools.description: Loads an ONNX model and returns its input/output metadata (name, element type, shape). Use this before WinmlRunFloat32 to discover tensor shapes.

tools.name: winml_list_providers
tools.description: Lists ONNX Runtime execution providers available in the current process (e.g. CPUExecutionProvider, DmlExecutionProvider, CUDAExecutionProvider). Reflects whatever EPs Windows ML / the loaded native dll registered.

tools.name: winml_run_float32
tools.description: Runs inference on an ONNX model with float32 tensor inputs. inputsJson: '{"input_name":{"shape":[1,3,224,224],"data":[0.1,0.2,...]}}'. executionProvider: 'cpu' (default) | 'dml' (DirectML, any GPU) | 'cuda' (NVIDIA). Returns the first output tensor as float32 JSON.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Writes UTF-8 text to a file. Creates parent directories as needed. Set append=true to append instead of overwrite.

tools.name: wsl_execute
tools.description: Runs a command in an existing WSL distribution using an argv array, with a 30-second bound and captured stdout/stderr. command must contain the executable followed by arguments; it is never concatenated into a shell command. For deliberate shell scripting, pass /bin/sh, -lc, and the script as separate command entries.

tools.name: wsl_get_status
tools.description: Returns the local WSL installation status. This is read-only and reports the Windows WSL configuration, default distribution, and kernel information when available.

tools.name: wsl_list_distributions
tools.description: Lists installed WSL distributions with their state and WSL version. This is read-only; it never starts, terminates, imports, exports, or unregisters a distribution.

tools.name: wsl_list_processes
tools.description: Lists Linux processes in an existing WSL distribution. This is read-only and returns PID, parent PID, command, and arguments.

tools.name: wsl_read_only_probe
tools.description: Runs one fixed, read-only diagnostic inside an existing WSL distribution. probe must be one of: system-info, re-toolchain, processes, mounts, or network. No arbitrary shell command is accepted.

tools.name: wsl_send_signal
tools.description: Sends HUP, INT, TERM, or KILL to one exact Linux PID in an existing WSL distribution. Call wsl_list_processes first to identify the target PID.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Navigate back in the page history (equivalent to the browser back button).

tools.name: browser_clear_cookies
tools.description: Wipe every cookie from the jar.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element. Pass `ref` (preferred, from browser_snapshot / browser_interactive_elements) OR a `selector`.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the current browser page and reset state

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Return the console messages logged by the current page

tools.name: browser_count
tools.description: Count how many elements on the page match a CSS selector. Cheap existence / pagination probe.

tools.name: browser_detect_forms
tools.description: List every <form> on the page with its action URL, method, and a description of each input/textarea/select. Use to understand a form's structure before filling it in.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page context and return the result

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.description: Extract a structured object from the page given a map of {field_name: css_selector}. Returns one JSON object with each field set to the matching element's text content (or attribute via 'selector@attr' syntax, e.g. 'a@href'). For list extraction, append '[]' to the field name (e.g. 'rows[]') and the value will be an array.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Set the value of an input element. Pass `ref` (preferred) OR `selector`.

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple inputs in one call. `fields` is an array of {ref?, selector?, value, type?}. type='text' (default) sets value, type='check'/'uncheck' toggles checkboxes, type='select' picks an option by value or visible text. Saves N round-trips vs N browser_fill calls.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in the page history.

tools.name: browser_get_attribute
tools.description: Read an attribute of an element (href, src, value, class, data-*, etc.). Returns the raw attribute value as a string, or empty string if missing.

tools.name: browser_get_cookies
tools.description: Return all cookies in the browser's cookie jar as one JSON object per line.

tools.name: browser_interactive_elements
tools.description: List every clickable / typeable element on the current page with a stable ref ID and a brief description. Use this BEFORE clicking or filling so you can refer to elements by ref instead of guessing a CSS selector. Refs look like 'e3' and stay valid until the next navigation.

tools.name: browser_links
tools.description: List every anchor link on the current page as one JSON object per line: {text, href}. Use when you need to enumerate where to navigate next.

tools.name: browser_markdown
tools.description: Extract the current page as Markdown (headings, paragraphs, lists, links, code blocks). Use this instead of browser_snapshot when you want token-dense structured content rather than plain text.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL and wait for the page to load

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Return the list of network requests made by the current page

tools.name: browser_pdf
tools.description: Export the current rendered document as a paginated raster PDF using print media and bounded PDF defaults.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Dispatch a keyboard event on an element or the document

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload the current page.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current rendered viewport as a PNG image. Width and height default to the page's current CSS viewport.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or an element. `direction` is 'top'|'bottom'|'up'|'down'|'left'|'right' (default 'down'). `amount` in pixels (default viewport height). Use 'bottom' to trigger infinite-scroll loaders.

tools.name: browser_search
tools.description: Find substring matches in the visible page text. Returns each match with its surrounding context. Use this to confirm content exists before scraping or to locate a section.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option from a <select> element

tools.name: browser_set_cookie
tools.description: Add or replace a cookie in the jar. Use this to skip a login flow when you already have a session token.

tools.name: browser_set_storage_state
tools.description: Restore session state previously returned by browser_storage_state. Pass the JSON object. Use to bring an authenticated session back without re-logging in.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Get the current page content as text (title, URL, and readable body text)

tools.name: browser_storage_state
tools.description: Export the full authentication / session state (cookies + localStorage + sessionStorage) as a JSON object. Save this to skip a login on a subsequent run via browser_set_storage_state.

tools.name: browser_tab_close
tools.description: Close a tab by ID (default: the active tab). If you close the active tab, the next remaining tab becomes active.

tools.name: browser_tab_list
tools.description: List all open tabs with their ID, URL, title, and which one is active.

tools.name: browser_tab_new
tools.description: Open a new tab (isolated browser page). Returns the tab ID; subsequent tool calls operate on the most recently opened or browser_tab_switch'd tab.

tools.name: browser_tab_switch
tools.description: Switch the active tab. All subsequent tool calls (snapshot, click, etc.) target this tab.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an input element (appends to existing value). Pass `ref` (preferred) OR `selector`.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for a CSS selector to appear in the DOM

tools.name: browser_wait_for_text
tools.description: Wait until a substring appears anywhere in the rendered page text. Use when you want to wait for a result message or notification rather than a specific selector.
